principles: The route is classified before generative reasoning.
Stored personal or organizational facts require reviewed evidence retrieval.
One-step no-write work stays in Agentic Butler; multi-step work may use Skill Orchestrator.
Critical Faculty is conditional, never a default hop.
Learning is post-turn unless its result is explicitly required now.
External side effects and generated-capability activation remain approval-gated.

migration_boundary.rule: Azure code and n8n must consume the same contract and must not reinterpret route semantics.

background_work.rule: The backend creates the trusted worker override. Browser metadata can never force synchronous worker execution.
